description: This bar chart illustrates the number of sentences, measured in thousands (K), across various text categories. The horizontal axis, labeled "Categories," lists the following categories in left-to-right order: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and an unlabeled gray bar at the far right. The vertical axis, labeled "Sentences (K)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 200. Each bar is colored red and topped with a blue numerical label indicating its exact value. The bars represent the following values: Administrative has 525K sentences, Religion has 50K, Non-fiction has 190K, Fiction has 35K, Law has 23K, News has 902K, Science has 110K, and the final unlabeled gray bar has 2K sentences. The bars are arranged in descending order of their values, with News being the tallest bar at 902K and the gray bar the shortest at 2K. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and numerical labeling.
